    - heading "Accessibility" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: A section labelled by its title; the bar and every limit are meters with their value as text ("7,420 of 10,000 credits")
      - listitem: The period switch is a radio group with a roving tab stop
      - listitem: The category tooltip is a polite live region, so stepping through the bar reads each part
      - listitem: Running low and reaching the limit are announced in a polite live region; amber and red are never the only signal – the text says it too
    - heading "Motion" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: On first view the bar fills from zero and every number counts up, in one frame loop so numbers and widths stay in step
      - listitem: "Switching periods: the light fill glides to the new option, numbers roll to their new values and the parts glide to their new widths"
      - listitem: A category that drops out shrinks to nothing on the bar while its legend row folds away; the card glides to its new height
      - listitem: Hovering a part dims the others and highlights its legend row; the tooltip glides along the bar
      - listitem: Near the limit the share tag turns amber (red at the limit), a small dot pops in and the button turns dark with a gentle nudge, its width gliding to the new label
      - listitem: With prefers-reduced-motion everything switches instantly
    - heading "Responsive behavior" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: Fills its container up to 460px; at 400px and below the switch gets its own row and the limits stack as rows
      - listitem: Works down to 320px wide; long labels end with an ellipsis, numbers and units never split
      - listitem: "Touch: tapping a part or a legend row shows its value, targets grow to 36–38px"
      - listitem: "Dark mode built in: switches when an ancestor (usually <html>) has the class dark or data-theme=\"dark\""
